calibration_rule: Adaptation-only F1, then balanced accuracy, then higher threshold
population: Fit all other TRAIN-pool participants, no target-person data; fixed threshold
personal: Fit only target-person non-held-out blocks; fixed threshold
population_calibrated: Same population classifier; choose threshold on target adaptation blocks only
eligibility: Based on adaptation class support and input availability only, never evaluation labels or scores
primary: Paired pooled precision/recall/F1 and false-positive rate; per-person and split-kind results
negative_only: Population-only negative controls retained separately; no claimed personal FoG performance
interpretation: Exploratory blocked cross-validation within TRAIN14, not a new blind TEST or prospective next-day trial
